meta.title: Gate × cohort explorer
meta.question: At which gate does each cohort's experience differ from everyone's?
caveats: Group-level only. A difference shown here is not a significance test (T03 holds the tests).
A cohort or item base below n = 25 is shown but not compared.
Target has no headline measures: its questions are the screeners that define the cohorts.
meta.provenance: Values RECON_DATA via T02; headline measures confirmed by Scott (P4.S01).
